System dependencies
--------------------
CHANGEME: only if there's a non-pip system package/driver needed (kernel module, vendor SDK,

Install *pyobs-CHANGEME*
--------------------------
Clone the repository:

    git clone https://github.com/pyobs/pyobs-CHANGEME.git
    cd pyobs-CHANGEME

Install it with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

    uv sync
